authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10978 lavaṇa explicitly gives Niṅg. lõ and regional lūṇ/lōn salt. Nasalized lõ/lū̃ fit contraction of this salt word; bare Gujari nu requires confirming nasal loss rather than relying on the old match. Exact survey form lō̃ is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
